page_title: REI 1-2 BRE | Reims v Brest 17/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+1' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Marco Bizot (Brest) gets booked.
90+1' Here comes a substitution. Romain Del Castillo is given a rest as he is replaced by Achraf Dari (Brest).
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Amine Salama (Reims) sends a cross into the box, but Marco Bizot comes off his line to gather the ball.
89' Steve Mounie (Brest) has tested the patience of referee Gael Angoula and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
85' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Marshall Munetsi (Reims) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
81' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest. Teddy Teuma (Reims) fails to convert a close-range free kick as he sends the ball narrowly over the bar.
79' The resulting corner, taken by Bilal Brahimi (Brest), comes to nothing.
77' Here is a change. Thomas Foket is going off and William Still gives the last tactical orders to Amine Salama (Reims).
77' Substitution. Mamadou Diakhon (Reims) in, Keito Nakamura out.
77' Substitution. Mahdi Camara did his best and is replaced by Adrien Lebeau (Brest).

75' Thomas Foket clips a neat ball into the box towards Junya Ito (Reims), whose header from the centre of the box goes narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.
74' Junya Ito (Reims) gets to the ball from the resulting corner kick and attempts to curl it past the keeper. His wild shot sails wide of the goal.
74' Teddy Teuma (Reims) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
73' Gael Angoula blows his whistle and it's Bilal Brahimi (Brest) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
72' Teddy Teuma (Reims) takes the corner but it's cleared.
72' An attempted cross from Thomas Foket (Reims) is cleared. Corner kick. Reims will have an opportunity.
70' Junya Ito (Reims) plays a through ball but overhits it.
68' The resulting corner from Bilal Brahimi (Brest) is cleared.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jeremy Le Douaron departs the field of play to be replaced by Bilal Brahimi (Brest).
66' Eric Roy has decided to make a change. Jonas Martin (Brest) replaces Hugo Magnetti.
66' A substitution has been made. Martin Satriano is replaced by Steve Mounie (Brest).

63' Mohamed Daramy (Reims) must be feeling really frustrated right now. He managed to meet the rebound and sent in a nice header from close range. However, Marco Bizot pulled off an amazing save out of the blue to deny his promising effort towards the roof of the net.
62' The corner from Junya Ito (Reims) is hurriedly cleared.

62' Junya Ito (Reims) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball goes out of play. Reims are awarded a corner kick.
62' Teddy Teuma (Reims) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

61' A neat pass is well received by Teddy Teuma (Reims), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot. Now Reims have a corner.
60' We are about to witness a substitution. Marshall Munetsi (Reims) is replacing Amir Richardson.
60' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Azor Matusiwa.
60' William Still has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mohamed Daramy (Reims) replacing Oumar Diakite.

56' 1 - 2 GOAL! Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) receives the ball after a swift counter attack. Still with some work to do, he weaves his way through the defence to score a wonderful goal from mid range to make it 1:2.
55' Reims can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
54' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
54' Brest get a corner.
52' A yellow-coloured card is received by Thibault De Smet (Reims).
50' 1 - 1 Goal! Mahdi Camara (Brest) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the left side of the goal. It's 1:1.
50' Mahdi Camara (Brest) takes a nice first touch to control a cross and fires at goal from near the penalty spot, but his effort only hits the left-hand post!
50' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
48' Bradley Locko (Brest) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Eric Roy (Brest) gets a yellow card, off the field.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Keito Nakamura (Reims) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Marco Bizot is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
44' Teddy Teuma (Reims) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
44' Oumar Diakite (Reims) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block. The ball is out of play. Reims will have a chance to score from a corner.
43' Junya Ito (Reims) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The ball has crossed the sideline. Reims are taking a throw-in.
42' Teddy Teuma (Reims) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

42' Junya Ito (Reims) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot to the right side of the goal, but is thwarted by a great save from Marco Bizot. Reims have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
40' Kenny Lala (Brest) sends a cross in and finds Martin Satriano inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.
38' Amir Richardson (Reims) creates space for himself on the edge of the box and smacks a hard shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's an easy save for Marco Bizot.
36' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
36' Gael Angoula shows a yellow card to Hugo Magnetti (Brest) for his blatant foul.
36' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Brest have a corner.
34' The linesman signals that Bradley Locko (Brest) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
34' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
34' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. It will be a corner kick for Brest.
33' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

33' The referee points to the corner flag and Brest will take a corner. Kenny Lala (Brest) decides to have a go at goal from the edge of the box, but the wall jumps as one and blocks the free kick. Danger averted!
32' The free kick will be taken by Kenny Lala (Brest).
32' Thomas Foket (Reims) brings his opponent down. Gael Angoula has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Brest earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
30' Kenny Lala (Brest) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
27' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
26' Kenny Lala (Brest) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. Brest win a corner.
25' Kenny Lala (Brest) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Yehvann Diouf.
22' Azor Matusiwa (Reims) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Gael Angoula had an easy-decision to make.

19' 1 - 0 Amir Richardson (Reims) gets to the ball inside the penalty area and produces a bullet header towards the goal. He aims his effort nicely inside the left post, leaving Marco Bizot helpless. He makes it 1:0.
19' It seemed like Teddy Teuma (Reims) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
18' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kenny Lala (Brest) was quite harsh and Gael Angoula didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
14' Brest fail to score from a corner as Yehvann Diouf (Reims) leaps to collect the ball.
13' Flag up against Oumar Diakite (Reims). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
11' Keito Nakamura (Reims) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!

10' Thomas Foket (Reims) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Junya Ito, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Reims.
9' Keito Nakamura (Reims) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender.
6' Junya Ito (Reims) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender. The ball goes out of play and Brest will have a goal kick.
6' The ball is cleared after Oumar Diakite (Reims) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Reims.
5' Oumar Diakite (Reims) is caught offside!
4' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) produces a long-range strike, but he only hits one of his own teammates standing in its way.
3' Junya Ito (Reims) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Reims will have the kick-off.
Gael Angoula will referee today's match.
